title: Towers of Hanoi
hints: To move n disks from `from` to `to`, first move the top n-1 disks out of the way onto `via`, then move the largest disk, then move the n-1 disks back on top of it.

The recursive calls swap the roles of the pegs: the first moves n-1 disks from `from` to `via` (using `to` as spare), the second from `via` to `to` (using `from` as spare). The base case is n == 0: no moves.
if n == 0 { return nil }; moves := Hanoi(n-1, from, via, to); moves = append(moves, from+"->"+to); return append(moves, Hanoi(n-1, via, to, from)...)
